title: Into the tunnel
base_prompt:
Fully animated cinematic stylized-realistic 3D CGI feature-film shot, continuous motion, expressive character animation and acting, believable fur and cloth simulation, detailed wet stone and metal, dynamic ocean, rain, spray, steam and sparks, cinematic lighting, anamorphic 16:9 widescreen, 24 fps.
Setting: a flooded stone-and-iron maintenance tunnel beneath the lighthouse, knee-deep seawater, dripping pipes, rusted conduits. Time and weather: dim interior lit by handheld lamps and emerald glows, cold blue shadows.
Characters (keep exactly on-model): the masked hero, a lean athletic acrobat in a rain-soaked, storm-grey and signal-orange weatherproof bodysuit with reflective silver safety-tape chevrons across the chest and limbs, a smooth brass-rimmed diving-style mask-helmet with two round amber lantern-glass eye lenses that narrow and widen expressively, a climbing harness, and brass winch gauntlets on both wrists that fire braided orange grapple cables tipped with small folding hooks; Penny, a fourteen-year-old girl with windblown auburn curls under a patterned headscarf, freckles, a heavy canvas mechanic's apron full of wrenches, pliers and gears, and a grease-stained linen rag; clever, practical, young-looking; Tomkin, a compact, stout ginger-and-white tabby cat walking upright, wearing a thick ribbed grey wool sock folded over his ears like a baker's toque, a lavender silk boxer-shorts cape fastened at the neck with a brass safety pin, wielding a bent stainless-steel soup ladle like a rapier and carrying a yellow plastic butter tub; expressive, brave and comically self-important.
Camera: tracking backward ahead of the trio wading; one continuous shot, no cuts.
Action: The masked hero leads them through knee-deep water in the tunnel, lamp held high; Penny wades behind; Tomkin rides inside the butter tub floating along like a little boat, paddling with his ladle.
No dialogue.
Sound: wading splashes, echoing drips, ladle paddling.
Audio: realistic sound effects and ambience only; spoken dialogue only as written above; no background music; no narrator.
